infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photo library to allow you to attach photos to reports.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need access to your camera so you can take photos for reports.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone is used when recording videos with sound (not required for photos).
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We need your location to verify where the pickup was completed and to show your location on the map.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow TrashTrack to use your location.
